content: इष्टिः {%f.%} [इष्-क्तिन्] .²1 Wish, request, desire. .²2 Seeking, striving to get. .²3 Any desired object. .²4 A desired rule or desideratum; (a term used with reference to Patañjaliʼs additions to Kātyāyanaʼs Vārttikas; इष्टयो भाष्यकारस्य, इति भाष्यकारेष्टया <ab>&c.</ab>; <ab>cf.</ab> उपसंख्यान). .²5 Impulse, hurry. .²6 Invitation, order. .²7 (यज्-क्तिन्) A sacrifice. <ls>Ms. 11. 2. 20</ls>. शबर seems to interpret the word especially in the sense of ‘a दर्शपूर्णमास sacrifice’. इष्टिराजसूयचातुर्मास्येषु . <ab>&c.</ab> <ls>MS. 11. 2. 12</ls>. .²8 An oblation consisting of butter, food <ab>&c.</ab> .²9 Summary in verses (= संग्रहश्लोक). एभिर्यज्ञेभिस्तदभीष्टिमश्याम् <ls>Rv. 1. 166. 14</ls>.
